hints.title: Boundary Contraction Obstacle
hints.text: Traversing an M x N grid in clockwise concentric layers requires avoiding visiting already processed cells or overrunning non-square dimensions. How can contracting four directional boundaries sequence the walk cleanly?

hints.title: Four Wall Bounding Invariant
hints.text: Maintain top, bottom, left, and right boundary pointers. After traversing along each wall, shrink that boundary inward until top exceeds bottom or left exceeds right.

hints.title: Perimeter Shrinking Procedure
hints.text: Initialize top = 0, bottom = m - 1, left = 0, right = n - 1. While left <= right and top <= bottom: traverse col from left to right along top, then increment top. Traverse row from top to bottom along right, then decrement right. If top <= bottom, traverse col from right to left along bottom, then decrement bottom. If left <= right, traverse row from bottom to top along left, then increment left.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every cell is visited and appended exactly once in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direction tracking without explicit boundary bounds requires auxiliary visited matrices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boundary index variables consume constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling non-square matrices and avoiding double-visiting single middle rows or columns.
